title: Can Language Models Replace Programmers for Coding? REPOCOD Says 'Not Yet'
abstract: arXiv:2410.21647v5 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Recently, a number of repository-level code generation benchmarks-such as CoderEval, DevEval, RepoEval, RepoBench, and LongCodeArena-have emerged to evaluate the capabilities of large language models (LLMs) beyond standalone benchmarks like HumanEval and MBPP. Thus, a natural question is, would LLMs have similar performance in real world coding tasks as their performance in these benchmarks? Unfortunately, one cannot answer this question, since these benchmarks consist of short completions, synthetic examples, or focus on limited scale repositories, failing to represent real-world coding tasks.   To address these challenges, we create REPOCOD, a Python code-generation benchmark containing complex tasks with realistic dependencies in real-world large projects and appropriate metrics for evaluating source code. translated_title: 语言模型能否替代程序员进行编码？REPOCOD的回答是“尚不能”
translated_abstract: 最近，许多仓库级代码生成基准（如CoderEval、DevEval、RepoEval、RepoBench和LongCodeArena）相继出现，用于评估大型语言模型（LLM）在HumanEval和MBPP等独立基准之外的能力。由此产生一个自然的问题：LLM在真实世界编码任务中的表现是否会与其在这些基准上的表现相当？遗憾的是，目前无法回答这个问题，因为这些基准由简短的补全任务、合成示例组成，或仅关注规模有限的仓库，无法代表真实世界的编码任务。为解决这些挑战，我们创建了REPOCOD，这是一个Python代码生成基准，包含来自真实世界大型项目中具有现实依赖关系的复杂任务，并配有适合评估源代码的指标。该基准包含来自11个热门项目的980个完整函数生成任务，其中50.8%的任务需要仓库级上下文信息。
tldr: 该论文提出了REPOCOD基准，包含来自11个真实热门项目的980个Python完整函数生成任务，以评估语言模型在真实世界编码任务中的能力，结果显示当前语言模型尚不能替代程序员。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces REPOCOD, a Python code-generation benchmark with 980 whole-function generation tasks from 11 popular real-world projects, demonstrating that current language models cannot yet replace programmers in real-world coding tasks.
